checks.name: RQ-018 Bronze definition unique client actif
checks.definition:
checks for crm_contrat:
  - ecart_client_actif:
      name: RQ-018 Bronze definition unique client actif
      ecart_client_actif query: |
        WITH actifs AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id AS client_id
          FROM crm_contrat c
          JOIN crm_client k
            ON k.client_id = c.souscripteur_id AND k._batch_id = c._batch_id
          WHERE c._batch_id = 'L-2026-10-14'
            AND c.souscripteur_id IS NOT NULL
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_debut, '%Y-%m-%d') <= '2026-10-01'
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_fin, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2026-10-01'
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_derniere_cotisation, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2026-07-01'
        ),
        directions AS (
          SELECT 'Commerciale' AS direction
          UNION ALL SELECT 'Sinistres'
          UNION ALL SELECT 'Risques'
        ),
        comptes AS (
          SELECT d.direction, COUNT(a.client_id) AS nb_clients
          FROM directions d
          LEFT JOIN actifs a ON TRUE
          GROUP BY d.direction
        )
        SELECT MAX(nb_clients) - MIN(nb_clients) AS ecart FROM comptes
      fail: when > 0

directions AS (

),
comptes AS (
